text:
Morgan (Partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a private-offer pilot with NimbusCloud Appliance partner. Idea: 6-month committed spend in marketplace with SKU-tiered discounts + renewal uplift. Thoughts?
Ravi (Sales): Love it. What's target commit? 3-6M ARR? need floor for reserved capacity?
Morgan (Partnerships): thinking $600k over 6 months (monthly metered) to start. 15% discount band at SKUs above $100k/mo, 10% at 50-100k, 5% below. Renewal bump: +3% credit if they renew within 30 days.
Samir (Product): Need to confirm model routing + Dedicated eligible. Can we limit use to hosted models to protect runtime SLAs?
Elena (Legal): Need to see contract language for 'renewal bump' — could trigger revenue recognition issues. Also check termination rights for private offers.
Laura (Marketing): For co-announce we'll need a joint case study template and half-day launch webinar. Timing?
Ravi (Sales): Partner wants announcement aligned with their Q3 roadshow — target week of May 20. Is that feasible ops-wise?
Morgan (Partnerships): Ops should be fine if we sign by May 1. @Samir can you flag any infra gating?
Samir (Product): I'll audit capacity. One ask: require burst capacity gating to prevent noisy neighbor. Also suggest a soft launch to a pilot tenant.
partner-bot: [autogenerated] Marketplace private-offer draft created: PO-44321. Link: https://marketplace.internal/PO-44321
Elena (Legal): I'll review PO-44321 by EOD Thursday. Need to loop in finance for discount approval.
Ravi (Sales): Finance ok with up to 15% if commit >= $1.8M total. Our $600k pilot below that, so we need exec ok or lower discount.
Morgan (Partnerships): ok — options: a) keep pilot 15% but cap seat to 3 months at that band, or b) reduce to 10% for pilot. Quick vote?
Laura (Marketing): prefer b) 10% — easier on finance and cleaner messaging.
Samir (Product): vote b).
Ravi (Sales): agree b). I'll update partner.
Morgan (Partnerships): will update PO and schedule a 30-min kick next Tue. Thanks all :thumbsup:
